correctness.rationale: PASS. At the source RESULT.md, the standard complex symmetric-bilinear block-monomial ruling embedding has orthogonal projector P(t)=diag(v_i(t)^T v_i(t)/s_i(t)) with s_i=sum_{j=0}^{n_i} t^{2j}. For real rank-matched data Q the critical trace derivative is the derivative of R_Q/L, L=lcm_i s_i. The exhibited genuine rank-d block projector data Q_u produce all simple finite poles; independence of two blocks and a parameter-incidence codimension argument exclude multiple nonpole critical roots and cut-locus intersections. The expansion at infinity has generic nonzero linear term. Riemann-Hurwitz on P^1 gives 2 deg L-2 simple off-cut critical points, and the nonempty Zariski-open conditions extend to all general rank-d projector data. Domain: complex characteristic-zero bilinear projection metric, d>=2, all n_i>=2, generic Q. The full prior 2026-10-18 proof independently verifies the same statement. A separate exact cyclotomic computation gives deg L=10 for S(2,3), hence 18; this example is not an all-parameter proof.
